verses.text: For the music director. Of David, the servant of the LORD. I have a message in my heart about the sin of the wicked: they have no fear of God at all.
They think so highly of themselves that they cannot see their own sin and hate it.
The words they speak are evil and full of lies. They have stopped being wise and doing good.
Even in bed they plan evil. They choose a path that is not good. They do not turn away from evil.
LORD, your faithful love reaches to the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
Your goodness is like the mighty mountains. Your fair judgments are like the deep ocean. LORD, you take care of people and animals.
God, how precious your faithful love is! People find safety in the shadow of your wings.
They eat their fill of the rich food in your house. You let them drink from your river of delights.
You are the spring of life. Your light lets us see light.
Keep showing your faithful love to those who know you, and your goodness to those whose hearts are honest.
Do not let proud people trample on me. Do not let the hands of the wicked drive me away.
Look how the evil people have fallen! They are thrown down and cannot get up.
